properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated April 23, [1944]; includes description of journey across the Caribbean islands and down the South American Coast to Belem and Natal along the “military route”; plans to fly over to the African coast.
